Answer: E
Reason: The coronal CT image (Figure 1) shows a distinct, rounded hyperdense mass in the lateral aspect of the right mid-lung zone, consistent with the right middle lobe. This location corresponds to option E, which describes a laterally positioned pseudoaneurysm in the right middle lobe; the other options describe locations (RUL, RLL, LUL, LLL) or positions (medial, anterior) that do not match the visible lateral mid-zone lesion.
